LESSON: CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING 3.3 Handwriting By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners observe dis
Topic 3.4: Creative writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Creative writing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when writing creative texts texts), in pairs and groups paragraphs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate a sense of ownership in writing competitions at school and 184 the written work through various media (newspaper, children magazines)

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Creative writing

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Creative writing

Teach
• Focus skill: demonstrate a sense of ownership in writing competitions at school and 184 the written work through various media (newspaper, children magazines).
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Creative writing.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Creative writing
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when writing creative texts texts), in pairs and groups paragraphs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
